versions.changelog: New home command: the signed-in account home timeline, newest first, up to 3,200 posts, with full text for long posts and reposts; --exclude retweets,replies.

Security hardening for the ClawHub audit; the skill's name is now x-api-v2, its slug.
- post shows a preview and posts only with --yes.
- The sign-in is stored owner-only (mode 600). OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and a random state; auth --manual and --code for headless sessions; logout revokes the sign-in at X.
- --json on every command: one JSON document on stdout, errors included.
- config.json in ~/.openclaw/x, overridden by X_BEARER_TOKEN, X_CLIENT_ID and X_CLIENT_SECRET. 1.0 setups keep working.
- likes asks for like.read (run auth once more), thread lists oldest first, tweets reports posts it can't find.
- SKILL.md declares its permissions and documents X API v2 search operators.
Upgrading from 1.0: settings under skills.entries.x in openclaw.json move to skills.entries.x-api-v2.

Initial release of x-api-v2 skill.

- Access X (Twitter) via API v2 for user profiles, timelines, threads, search, bookmarks, likes, and posting tweets.
- Supports public data (via bearer token) and user-private actions (via OAuth 2.0).
- Pure Python stdlib implementation — no dependencies required.
- All commands output clean, readable text for easy integration and scripting.
- Includes rate limit and billing/costs info, advanced search operators, and troubleshooting guidance.
